documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Corrin Gospel-book (fictional).
In this document "CG-MS" means Corrin Gospel-book. Corrin Gospel-book reports folio count of 268 for FY2025. Corrin Gospel-book reports lacunae share of 7.214% for FY2024. Corrin Gospel-book reports quire count of 23.046 for FY2025. Corrin Gospel-book reports recorded variant readings of 2215 for FY2025 under the original agreement. For Corrin Gospel-book, the place of origin is: copied in the northern scriptorium.

documents.title: Catalogue entry
documents.text:
Catalogue entry — Corrin Gospel-book (fictional).
Corrin Gospel-book reports folio count of 220 for FY2024. Corrin Gospel-book reports lacunae share of 7.2% for FY2024. Corrin Gospel-book reports line count of 21 for FY2024. CG-MS reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 1157 year for FY2025. For Corrin Gospel-book, the place of origin is: copied in the southern scriptorium.

Review article — Corrin Gospel-book (fictional).
Corrin Gospel-book reports quire count of 23 for FY2025. Corrin Gospel-book reports recorded variant readings of 2755 for FY2025 under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Corrin Logistics subsidiary reports line count of 17 for FY2024. Corrin Gospel-book reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 933 year for FY2025.
